newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Oct 30.

text.p: Exxon Corp is negotiating with Qatar to build the industry's first plant that would make commercial quantities of liquid diesel fuel and other products from natural gas, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
- U.S. investor Marvin Davis has offered to buy Carter-Wallace Inc for $835 million or $18 a share.
- DFS Group said its equity owners agreed to sell the majority of their holdings to LVMH Moet Hennessy-Louis Vuitton .
- Bay Networks Inc has appointed Intel Corp executive David House as its chairman, president and chief executive officer.
- America Online Inc plans a $385 million pre-tax charge to reverse an accounting treatment.
- More than 7,500 members of the United Automobile Workers union went on strike at two plants of General Motors Corp .
- News Corp Ltd named its top movie officer as president.
- Patty Stonesifer quit as senior vice president in charge of Microsoft Corp's interactive media unit.
- USX Corp saw its quarterly net income surge 34 percent.
- Leslie Fay's former chief financial officer was charged in a federal indictment involving accounting fraud.
- Sun Microsystems unveiled its new JavaStation network computer.
- Prudential Securities is expected to announce that Michael Madigan and William McCormick will assmue the daily duties of the firm's brokerage chief at year end.
International airline representatives will meet in Geneva to discuss actions to counter 10 percent higher fuel costs this year.
